title: Fix causal support/resistance and add independent tactical risk overlay
body:
Current candles previously participated in historical support/resistance, which could hide their own breakdown. Levels now use strictly prior dated candles; technical analysis filters future rows and carries the price observation timestamp into decisions.

Adds an independent configurable Tactical Risk Overlay with HOLD/REVIEW/TRIM and explanations. Strong fundamentals do not suppress tactical risk reduction. Decision and Strategy Engine expose the overlay separately; stale, missing or future-dated market observations force REVIEW and suppress target exposure changes. Market regime inputs are checked for freshness and sufficient history. Thresholds, age limits and trim fraction are configurable through ALPHA_RISK_* environment variables.

Validation: full offline pytest suite: 27 passed, 12 subtests passed. Python compileall and git diff --check passed. No failing tests. No production endpoints, databases, deployments or merge operations were invoked.

Risks and limitations: defaults are illustrative policy, not fitted to October or historically validated. ISO/UTC daily timestamps and fixed age windows do not model exchange sessions or holidays. Market producers must expose observation dates; created_at alone no longer proves freshness. Existing legacy decision/classification rules remain; overlay HOLD does not cancel a legacy TRIM/SELL. Manual levels require operator point-in-time provenance. Synthetic tests do not establish strategy effectiveness. Point-in-time walk-forward backtesting, adjusted prices, transaction costs and execution validation remain necessary.

See docs/risk-engine-v2.md for configuration, time/data contracts and limitations.
head: fix/risk-engine-v2
